title: A functional structure
caption: Grouping by specialism builds expertise: everyone in marketing reports into marketing. The chart has three levels, and the chief executive's span of control is three.
alt: Organisation chart with a chief executive over marketing, finance and operations, each with two teams.
description: Second level: the heads of marketing, finance and operations, each a direct report, so the span is 3.
Third level: two teams under each function.
